text: A Conditional Access policy that gets it wrong on day one can lock out everyone it applies to, all at once. A pilot scoped to a small group first limits the blast radius of any mistake.

Mara creates a security group, CA-Pilot-SOC-IT, containing the IT and Security team. The policy's assignment targets only that group, against all cloud apps, and requires multi-factor authentication and a compliant device for every sign-in.
Hartwell's break-glass account, an emergency admin account, is excluded from the policy's assignment explicitly, on day one -- not added as a fix after the first lockout.
Even with a volunteer pilot group and break-glass excluded, the policy first runs in report-only mode, logging what would have happened without enforcing anything.
Only after reviewing those report-only logs does Mara flip the policy to enforced for the pilot group. Next lesson writes Hartwell's first real incident-response runbook.
